pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with highly serrated, star-burst edges. The geometry is characterized by high-frequency, jagged pixel gradients at the interface with the light corridors. Spatial area is larger on the upper neck and transitions to more fragmented, smaller geometries on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A dense lattice of light-colored pathways with high continuity. Junction nodes are primarily trivalent and tetravalent intersections. Pixel thickness is narrow and relatively uniform throughout the mid-body region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette consisting of short, stiff hair projections against the blurred background.
